payload.acceptance_criteria:
When a personal skill differs from the project skill it shadows, the refusal shall name the exact command that refreshes it, basicly skills-user with the skill name.
When a personal skill has the same content as the project skill, the check shall not refuse.
payload.description:
## Context
On 2026-11-20 a basicly commit was refused by projection-hooks: the personal skill cli-tools in the user's Claude skills folder shadows the project skill cli-tools (different content); Claude loads the personal one. The gate found real drift (the project copy changed in b558a66e after the personal copy was installed), but the refusal names no fix. Findings: basicly install has no option that refreshes personal skills; basicly skills-user NAME writes them; terminal setup runs basicly skills-user from its pinned basicly release on every setup run, so the personal copy returns to the released version whenever basicly main is ahead of the latest release, and the refusal comes back.

## Confirmation Plan
Run the user_skills tests with a shadowing personal skill that differs and read the refusal text.
payload.title: Name the exact refresh command when a personal skill shadows a project skill
